high_priority_issues.label: Unsafe host double-booking
high_priority_issues.root_cause: The host double-booked the listing, causing safety and accommodation issues for guests.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement a real-time booking conflict detection system and enforce stricter host verification.

high_priority_issues.label: Booking Process Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Users find booking process confusing and restrictive.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Simplify booking flow and remove unnecessary pre-booking steps.

high_priority_issues.label: Customer Service Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers are dissatisfied due to slow response times and unhelpful support staff.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement a dedicated customer support training program and introduce a 24/7 live chat feature.

high_priority_issues.label: High fees and unclear policies
high_priority_issues.root_cause: High fees and unclear host policies lead to negative user experience.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Revise fee disclosure and host policy guidelines to improve transparency and trust.

high_priority_issues.label: Verification upload failure
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Backend error causing ID upload and MFA to fail
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate backend logs for ID upload and MFA endpoints, fix errors, deploy patch

high_priority_issues.label: Hide Close Friend Highlight
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Users want to hide close friend status highlight to maintain privacy
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Add an option in settings to disable the close friend status highlight

high_priority_issues.label: Account Suspended Unjustly
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Suspension policy enforcement is incorrectly flagging legitimate accounts as violations.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Review and adjust the automated suspension algorithm, and implement a transparent appeal workflow for affected users.

high_priority_issues.label: Account Suspension Issue
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Unclear suspension policy and lack of appeal option.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement a clear appeal workflow and dedicated support channel for suspended accounts.

high_priority_issues.label: Login stuck after update
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Login screen fails due to API mismatch after recent update.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Release a hotfix to restore login functionality and communicate fix to users.

high_priority_issues.label: Reels Performance and Auto-Refresh
high_priority_issues.root_cause: App crashes due to memory leaks during Reels playback and excessive auto-refreshing.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Optimize Reels rendering pipeline and reduce auto-refresh frequency.

high_priority_issues.label: Story editing and performance issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Missing cropping, slow highlight uploads, and no photo comments in Stories
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Fix image cropping, reduce highlight upload time, and enable photo comments in Stories

high_priority_issues.label: Missing Classic Movies
high_priority_issues.root_cause: The app lacks older movie titles
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Add a curated collection of classic movies to the catalog

high_priority_issues.label: Incorrect Availability Information
high_priority_issues.root_cause: AI incorrectly states content availability
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement a verification step to cross-check AI responses with actual catalog before presenting to users

high_priority_issues.label: Bank addition failure
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Bank addition feature not functioning for user
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate bank addition flow and fix integration issues

high_priority_issues.label: Device environment mismatch bug
high_priority_issues.root_cause: The app incorrectly identifies device environment, forcing uninstall of accessibility apps and causing UI updates to fail.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Prioritize a compatibility audit and release a patch that corrects environment checks to prevent forced uninstalls.

high_priority_issues.label: Data Prompt & Fee Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: The app incorrectly prompts to disable mobile data and fails to link accounts, while users report unclear platform fee charges.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate and fix the mobile data prompt logic, streamline account linking, and clarify platform fee structure in the app.

high_priority_issues.label: Fake Cashback Scam
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Fake cashback offers not delivered
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate cashback offer implementation and fix delivery issues

high_priority_issues.label: Bill payment sync issue
high_priority_issues.root_cause: The app does not update bill payment status in real time and the help section is automated and unhelpful
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Add a real‑time bill status sync feature and redesign the help section to provide manual support

high_priority_issues.label: Phone performance issue
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Phone performance issues causing app instability
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate device compatibility and optimize performance

high_priority_issues.label: Performance & Ad Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: App's inefficient caching and restrictive ad policy cause playback and offline issues
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Optimize offline caching and enable ad-based skip/next song options

high_priority_issues.label: Stale food & poor support
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Stale food and ineffective customer support.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement stricter food quality checks and train support staff.

high_priority_issues.label: Delivery Delays and Support
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers experience delayed deliveries and lack of support.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Improve delivery tracking and establish a dedicated support channel.

high_priority_issues.label: Order Not Received
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers report that their orders are not being taken or delivered, causing frustration.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate order processing workflow and implement real-time order status updates to improve transparency.

high_priority_issues.label: Delivery delays and late service
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Delivery partners consistently fail to meet estimated times, causing customer frustration
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Implement stricter partner performance metrics and real‑time ETA updates

high_priority_issues.label: Order Cancelled Without Reason
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers are experiencing unexpected order cancellations due to system errors or miscommunication with delivery staff.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Investigate cancellation workflow and implement a fail‑safe to prevent accidental cancellations; add a notification to customers explaining cancellation reasons.

high_priority_issues.label: High Prices & Delivery Stopped
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers feel prices are too high and delivery coverage has been reduced.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Review pricing tiers and expand delivery coverage to regain trust.

high_priority_issues.label: Driver fare dispute
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Drivers demand extra money, cancel rides, and customers face penalties with poor support
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Enforce strict fare policies and enhance customer support response times

high_priority_issues.label: Rider Trust & Service Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Riders report poor service and trust concerns, especially regarding payment and ride booking
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Conduct a comprehensive audit of rider feedback and implement a trust and safety improvement plan

high_priority_issues.label: Subscriber deletion & download bug
high_priority_issues.root_cause: App's backend incorrectly removes subscribers and blocks video downloads due to a bug.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Fix subscriber deletion bug and restore download functionality.

high_priority_issues.label: Ads & Performance Issues
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Excessive ads per video and app instability
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Reduce ad frequency to 3 per video and investigate crash logs

high_priority_issues.label: Missing supplies and high cost
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Customers complain about missing basic supplies and high charges.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Provide complimentary tissues and spoons with every order and conduct a pricing audit to align with customer expectations.

high_priority_issues.label: Low offers complaint
high_priority_issues.root_cause: Users feel the offers are not attractive enough.
high_priority_issues.pm_action: Increase the number and value of offers in the app.
